svg.title: A test entry at the top
svg.desc: Keep old rows fixed and insert the test entry above them. One moss edge marks a successful visible write; its position, not decorative glow, explains why another workload could notice it.

**Action:** A write primitive becomes a signaling primitive.

**Caption:**
